Hello again, everyone! Thanks to the users who contributed to [[User blog:KylaraE/Wiki coverage of the TV series|our previous discussion]] about where to best cover the TV series content. Your feedback has helped shape how the TV series will be documented, which is that it should be on a separate wiki. So here's what we do next to ensure this will work!

First, '''the TV series will primarily be documented on the (other) [[w:c:wot-prime|Wheel of Time Wiki]]''', which was created last year specifically for the TV series.

Second, we will '''develop a strong inter-linking strategy''' between these two wikis to prevent duplicative coverage. Users on the TV series wiki will be directed to this wiki if they want to learn more about the book series content, and users on this wiki will be directed to the TV series wiki if they want to learn more about the TV series content.

Here are some changes for this wiki for this to work:
* The TV series page itself will be updated to link to the cast/character pages on the TV series wiki. (And, similarly, the book series information page on the other wiki will be updated to link to pages on this wiki.)
* The cast pages on this wiki should be closed/migrated to the other wiki. Cast information is specific to the TV series, and so it should not be on this wiki.
* New pages on the TV series should not be created here, and should be deleted if they are.

Other inter-linking strategies could include things like this: Character pages here on the books wiki could have a short section on the TV series version covering some basic initial changes (once we have that information), and link to the TV series wiki character page for more information. Similarly, character pages on the TV series wiki would have a short section about changes from the book series character, and link to the character's page on this wiki for more information.

Please let me know if you have any questions, suggestions, concerns, or feedback! I'm here to help. :)
